nphi.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
nphi.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.with: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.

nphi.title: AFRITRAC – African Training Network for Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Modelling
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Africa CDC (partner); Université de Yaoundé I; USTTB Bamako; University of St Andrews; Makerere University; APHRC; University of Cape Coast; CERMEL; Mbarara University; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network training 35 early-career professionals through a harmonised master's programme and regional hub, with Tanzania's NIMR, Burundi's INSP and Africa CDC involved.

nphi.title: JICA–NMIMR Third Country Training Programme for African national laboratories
nphi.with: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research (NMIMR); national laboratory staff of West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: A JICA-funded laboratory training series hosted by Ghana's Noguchi Memorial Institute, launched after the West Africa Ebola outbreak, training national laboratory professionals from West, Central and Southern African countries in…

nphi.title: Africa CDC Central Africa Regional Collaborating Centre (Libreville)
nphi.with: Government of Gabon (host of Central Africa RCC, Libreville)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC operationalised its Central Africa RCC in Libreville in 2017, with Gabon providing offices, an emergency operations centre and biosafety labs to serve nine Central African states.

nphi.title: Africa CDC–ECDC antimicrobial stewardship training in Gabon
nphi.with: Africa CDC (incl. Central Africa Regional Coordinating Centre, Libreville); Ministry of Health Gabon
nphi.summary: September 2025 national One Health antimicrobial stewardship training in Lambaréné, co-organised by Africa CDC, ECDC and Gabon's Ministry of Health with a Gabon-adapted curriculum, under the AMR work package of the Africa CDC–ECDC…

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: PANDORA-ID-NET – Pan-African Network for Rapid Research, Response, Relief and Preparedness for Infectious Disease Epidemics
nphi.actor: Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); INMI Lazzaro Spallanzani (Italy); University College London; Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital; University of Zambia; Ifakara Health Institute; CERMEL Lambaréné; KNUST/KCCR; Charité; University of Tübingen

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 048 – Improved regional management of outbreaks in the African Atlantic Façade
nphi.with: Expertise France; Institut Pasteur; Fondation Mérieux; IRD; French Ministry of Health; CNCMFE NRBC-E; FIIAPP
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Santé publique France, Institut Pasteur and other French and Spanish bodies built outbreak preparedness and rapid-response teams in 11 West and Central African countries after the Ebola epidemic.
